requests.prompt: A dark editorial dashboard filling the frame. Across the top runs a wide strip carrying three very large numerals side by side with a small word beneath each, and a fourth smaller figure at its right end. Below the strip sit eight rectangular cards on a near-black surface, four across the upper row and four across the lower row, with generous gutters between them; four cards carry a bright amber bar down the left edge and a small rising line inside, and the other four are thin grey outlines with one dot in the corner. Modern print-design digital interface, flat vector rendering, confident sans-serif display type in the strip and small monospace rows in the cards, restrained palette of near-black, warm grey and a single amber accent, even soft light.

A dark editorial dashboard filling the frame, eight rectangular cards on a near-black surface, four across the upper row and four across the lower row with generous even gutters, every single card reduced to a thin cool grey outline with one small grey dot in its top corner and a short pale name in its upper left. No card has an accent bar, a chart, or any colour in it, and the whole frame is calm, spacious and deliberate rather than empty or broken. Modern print-design digital interface, flat vector rendering, restrained palette of near-black and two greys with no warm accent anywhere, even soft light, a narrow left rail of small pale names.
